findings.where: gradient key words ('agent era', 'one spine') and gradient metric figures
findings.evidence: Text uses a #3b5bff to #d94cff gradient fill; the magenta end (#d94cff) on white is about 3.3:1. Headline words pass the 3:1 large-text bar, but the gradient is also applied to card metrics and the ask-box figures where the light end falls near 3:1 on tinted card backgrounds.
findings.after: Solid #3b5bff (or darker) for figures; keep any gradient to >= 4.5:1 at its lightest stop
findings.why: WCAG 2.2 1.4.3 Contrast (Minimum) at the worst gradient stop (T-GRADIENT-STOPS).

findings.evidence: No <main> or landmarks; each slide is a <section> with no accessible name; the 180px ghost numerals ('01'...'07') are text, so a screen reader reads 'zero one, PROBLEM, Every design tool...' on every slide.
findings.after: aria-hidden="true" on .section-num and the cover blob; aria-label="Slide 2 of 10: Problem" on each section; wrap the deck in <main>
findings.why: WCAG 2.2 1.3.1 Info and Relationships and 1.1.1 Non-text Content (decorative content hidden).

findings.evidence: focus.json is empty: no focusable element on a 10-slide HTML deck. If the deck pages by arrow keys there is no visible or focusable control and no announced slide change; the '1 / 10' counter is plain text.
findings.before: No focusable controls; counter as text
findings.after: Prev/next <button>s with aria-labels and an aria-live="polite" slide counter

strengths: prefers-reduced-motion disables all anim-* entrance animations, and every slide's text is present with scripts off or observers blocked (hidden.json 2561/2561 chars in all conditions).
not_investigated: Live keyboard paging (arrow keys) not tested.
Sweep text-size hits (12-16px on a 1920 canvas) agreed and not repeated.
